method: Laboratory measurement, headless Chromium, single machine, CDP-emulated conditions. Not a field measurement and not a p75 claim.

duringBoot.note: Initial parse, execute and first render at 4x CPU throttle. Not a scroll task and not governed by the scroll budget. Reported so it is visible rather than hidden.

budgetNote: Programme budget: no long task above 50ms during ordinary scroll. Boot and scroll are attributed separately — see evidence/wave-d/scroll-performance/attribution.md for the Wave D.1 investigation that established the distinction.

supersedes.why: That figure was the maximum long task over the entire page lifetime, not over the scroll window. The harness reduced one cumulative list and labelled the result a scroll measurement. The original number is retained in evidence/wave-d/scroll-performance/attribution.md rather than deleted.
